## Contract

Inline the complete relevant component or infrastructure specification. Do not
send the executor to discover missing requirements in unrelated documents.

## Stop conditions

- Evidence conflicts with the contract.
- Required work crosses ownership boundaries.
- Shared foundation must change.
- A source asset, state, or mechanism is missing.

Report the blocker rather than guessing.
